title: Isolated verification command
responsibility: Runs a bounded command, captures its log and settles descendants before deciding whether the check passed.

inputs.name: runIsolated.run
inputs.description: Provides the command and arguments, working directory and environment, hard timeout, log destination, and captured-output byte cap. Optional `stdio` can be `'inherit'`; `signal` aborts, `onSpawn` receives the child PID, and `platform` supplies process-cleanup hooks.

outputs.name: runIsolated
outputs.description: Resolves to status, exit code and timeout flag, elapsed milliseconds, descendant survivors and cleanup counts, and the captured log's path, byte count, and SHA-256; it creates the log directory and writes the log before returning. `passed` requires exit code 0, no survivors, and known descendant state; on macOS it judges processes individually, while elsewhere it signals the command's process group.

errors.name: AbortError
errors.description: When `signal` is already aborted at entry, `throwIfAborted()` throws its reason unchanged; the default reason is a DOMException named `AbortError`.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Recursive creation of the parent directory for `run.log` and writing the captured bytes can reject with the filesystem error, so a command result is not returned if either operation fails.
